order = createPendingOrder(userId, serverPrice)
checkout = provider.createCheckout(order.ref, order.amount)
return checkout.url
Expected result: A checkout URL is returned; the order remains PENDING until confirmed.

Q: Why use a backend to create a payment?
A: It controls the price, merchant credentials and order reference.
